summary.text: Jeff Timberlake (listed on Ballotpedia as Jeffrey Timberlake) is a Republican who has served in the Maine State Senate since 2018 and previously served in the Maine House from 2010 to 2018. He is not seeking re-election to Senate District 17 and is the Republican candidate for Maine House District 91 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Timberlake graduated from Leavitt Area High School and earned an associate degree in business management from Central Maine Community College.
His career experience includes co-owning his family's farm, and he has been affiliated with the Kora Temple in Lewiston, the Nezinscot Masonic Lodge, and the Turner Ridge Riders Snowmobile Club.
Timberlake served in the Maine House of Representatives from District 75 from 2010 to 2018 and then moved to the Maine State Senate, where he represents District 17.
He became Senate minority leader in 2020 and was replaced in that role by Harold Stewart in 2022.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee and the Senatorial Vote Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary for House District 91 on June 9, 2026.
